# Zakaria Rajib — Sourcing, Wholesale, and Manufacturing Portfolio

> Zakaria Rajib is an independent Dhaka-based wholesale supplier and sourcing specialist providing ready-made apparel, sustainable jute & artisan handicrafts, and everyday tech accessories.

## Overview & Mission
- **Founder & Operator**: Zakaria Rajib
- **Location**: 34, Road 6/c, Sector 12, Uttara, Dhaka-1230, Bangladesh
- **Contact**: business@zakaria.com.bd | +880 13090 77997
- **Business Model**: Wholesale sourcing, custom production batches, export-grade fulfillment, and select retail supply.

## Key Sections & Offerings
- [What I Provide](https://zakaria.com.bd/#provide): Wholesale and retail supply across three core pillars:
  - **Clothing**: Custom and ready-made knitwear, denim, and woven apparel tailored for boutique and corporate orders.
  - **Jute & Handcraft**: Biodegradable jute products, diversified eco-textiles, and handcrafted homeware for international buyers.
  - **Tech Accessories**: Quality everyday electronic accessories, cables, chargers, and EDC hardware at volume pricing.
- [Journal](https://zakaria.com.bd/#writing): Curated daily updates and commentary covering the Bangladesh textile economy, sustainable export manufacturing, and regional business logistics.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://zakaria.com.bd/#contact): Direct B2B order consultation, sample requests, and wholesale quotations.

## WebMCP Actions for Agents
- **Filter Journal**: Action `filter-journal` accepts parameter `category` (`all`, `fashion-textile`, `business`).
- **Send Wholesale Enquiry**: Mailto link `mailto:business@zakaria.com.bd` with prefilled subject parameters for immediate order triage.
